And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of testimony, because the cloud overshadowed it, and the tent was filled with the glory of the Lord.

**Exodus 40:36**

And whenever the cloud went up from the tent, the sons of Israel set out with all their baggage.

**Exodus 40:37**

But if the cloud did not go up, they did not set out until the day the cloud went up.

**Exodus 40:38**

For cloud was upon the tent by day, and fire upon it by night, before all Israel in all their journeys."

## Leviticus

### Chapter 1

**Leviticus 1:1**

And the Lord called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of testimony, saying,

**Leviticus 1:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If a person from among you brings gifts to the Lord, you shall bring your gifts from the livestock, from the cattle and from the sheep.

**Leviticus 1:3**

If his gift is a whole burnt offering from the cattle, he shall bring a male without blemish to the entrance of the tent of testimony. He shall bring it as accepted before the Lord.

**Leviticus 1:4**

And he shall lay his hand on the head of the offering. It shall be accepted for him, to make atonement for him.

**Leviticus 1:5**

And they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood and pour the blood around on the altar, the one at the entrance of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 1:6**

And after flaying the whole burnt offering, they shall divide it by limbs.

**Leviticus 1:7**

And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall place fire on the altar and pile wood upon the fire.

**Leviticus 1:8**

And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pile the divided pieces and the head and the fat upon the wood on the fire that is on the altar.

**Leviticus 1:9**

And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priests shall place everything upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 1:10**

And if his gift to the Lord is from the sheep, from the lambs or from the young goats, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring it, a male without blemish, and he shall lay his hand on its head.

**Leviticus 1:11**

And they shall slaughter it on the side of the altar toward the north before the Lord, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 1:12**

And they shall divide it by limbs, with the head and the fat, and the priests shall pile them on the wood on the fire on the altar.

**Leviticus 1:13**

And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water, and the priest shall bring everything and place it upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 1:14**

And if he brings from the birds an offering as a gift to the Lord, he shall bring his gift from the turtledoves or from the pigeons.

**Leviticus 1:15**

And the priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head and place it on the altar, and he shall drain out the blood against the base of the altar.

**Leviticus 1:16**

And he shall remove the crop with its feathers and throw it beside the altar on the east, to the place of ashes.

**Leviticus 1:17**

And he shall split it open by the wings and shall not divide it, and the priest shall place it on the altar, on the wood on the fire. It is an offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

### Chapter 2

**Leviticus 2:1**

And if a person brings a sacrifice as a gift to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour, and he shall pour oil upon it and place frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.

**Leviticus 2:2**

And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and taking from it a full handful of the fine flour with the oil and all its frankincense, the priest shall place its memorial portion on the altar, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:3**

And what remains from the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and his sons, a holy of holies from the sacrifices of the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:4**

And if he brings as a gift a sacrifice baked in an oven, as a gift to the Lord, it shall be unleavened loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

**Leviticus 2:5**

And if your gift is a sacrifice from a griddle, it shall be fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened.

**Leviticus 2:6**

And you shall crumble them into pieces and pour oil upon them. It is a sacrifice to the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:7**

And if your gift is a sacrifice from a hearth-pan, it shall be made from fine flour with oil.

**Leviticus 2:8**

And he shall bring to the Lord the sacrifice that he makes from these, and he shall bring it to the priest and bring it near to the altar.

**Leviticus 2:9**

And the priest shall remove from the sacrifice its memorial portion and place it on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:10**

And what remains from the sacrifice shall belong to Aaron and his sons, a holy of holies from the offerings of the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:11**

Every sacrifice that you bring to the Lord you shall not make leavened, for no leaven and no honey shall you bring from it as an offering to the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:12**

You shall bring them to the Lord as a gift of firstfruits, but upon the altar they shall not be offered up as an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 2:13**

And every gift of your sacrifice shall be salted with salt. You shall not let the salt of the covenant of the Lord cease from your sacrifices. On every gift of yours you shall bring salt to the Lord your God.

**Leviticus 2:14**

And if you bring a sacrifice of first produce to the Lord, you shall bring fresh roasted grain, crushed from the tender growth, for the sacrifice of first produce.

**Leviticus 2:15**

And you shall pour oil upon it and place frankincense upon it. It is a sacrifice.

**Leviticus 2:16**

And the priest shall offer up its memorial portion from the crushed grain with the oil and all its frankincense. It is an offering to the Lord.

### Chapter 3

**Leviticus 3:1**

And if his gift to the Lord is a sacrifice of salvation, if he brings it from the cattle, whether male or female, he shall bring it without blemish before the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:2**

And he shall lay his hands on the head of the gift and slaughter it beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood around on the altar of whole burnt offerings.

**Leviticus 3:3**

And from the sacrifice of salvation they shall bring an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,

**Leviticus 3:4**

and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys.

**Leviticus 3:5**

And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall offer them on the altar upon the whole burnt offerings, upon the wood on the fire on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:6**

And if his gift from the sheep is a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, male or female, he shall bring it without blemish.

**Leviticus 3:7**

If he brings a lamb as his gift, he shall bring it before the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:8**

And he shall lay his hands on the head of his gift and slaughter it beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 3:9**

And from the sacrifice of salvation he shall bring an offering to God: the fat and the unblemished hind-part, he shall remove it with the lower back, and the fat of the belly,

**Leviticus 3:10**

and both kidneys and the fat on them, that on the thighs, and removing the lobe above the liver with the kidneys,

**Leviticus 3:11**

the priest shall offer it on the altar, an aroma of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:12**

And if his gift is from the goats, then he shall bring it before the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:13**

And he shall lay his hands on its head, and they shall slaughter it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 3:14**

And he shall bring from it an offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,

**Leviticus 3:15**

and both kidneys and all the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.

**Leviticus 3:16**

And the priest shall offer it on the altar, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. All the fat belongs to the Lord.

**Leviticus 3:17**

It is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings. You shall eat no fat and no blood.

### Chapter 4

**Leviticus 4:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 4:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, If a person sins unintentionally before the Lord in any of the commands of the Lord about things that ought not to be done, and does one of them,

**Leviticus 4:3**

if the anointed high priest sins so as to make the people sin, then he shall bring for his sin that he sinned a calf from the cattle, without blemish, to the Lord for his sin.

**Leviticus 4:4**

And he shall bring the calf to the entrance of the tent of testimony before the Lord, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the calf before the Lord and slaughter the calf before the Lord.

**Leviticus 4:5**

And the anointed priest whose hands have been consecrated shall take some of the blood of the calf and bring it into the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 4:6**

And the priest shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the holy curtain.

**Leviticus 4:7**

And the priest shall place some of the blood of the calf on the horns of the altar of the blended incense that is before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony, and he shall pour out all the blood of the calf at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings, which is by the doors of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 4:8**

And he shall remove from it all the fat of the calf for sin: the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,

**Leviticus 4:9**

and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys,

**Leviticus 4:10**

just as it is removed from the calf of the sacrifice of salvation. And the priest shall offer it on the altar of offering.

**Leviticus 4:11**

And the skin of the calf and all its flesh, with the head and the extremities and the belly and the dung,

**Leviticus 4:12**

they shall carry out the whole calf outside the camp to a clean place, where they pour out the ashes, and they shall burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

**Leviticus 4:13**

And if the whole assembly of Israel unintentionally fails to notice, and the matter escapes the eyes of the assembly, and they do one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and become guilty,

**Leviticus 4:14**

and the sin that they sinned in it becomes known to them, then the assembly shall bring a calf from the cattle, without blemish, for sin, and they shall bring it to the doors of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 4:15**

And the elders of the assembly shall lay their hands on the head of the calf before the Lord, and they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord.

**Leviticus 4:16**

And the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the calf into the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 4:17**

And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, in front of the holy curtain.

**Leviticus 4:18**

And the priest shall place some of the blood on the horns of the altar of the blended incense, which is before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony, and he shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar of offerings, the one by the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 4:19**

And he shall remove all the fat from it and offer it on the altar.

**Leviticus 4:20**

And he shall do to the calf just as he did to the calf for sin; so shall it be done. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

**Leviticus 4:21**

And they shall carry out the whole calf outside the camp and burn the calf as they burned the earlier calf. It is the sin-offering of the assembly.

**Leviticus 4:22**

And if a ruler sins and does one of all the commands of the Lord their God that must not be done, unintentionally, and sins and becomes guilty,

**Leviticus 4:23**

and the sin that he sinned becomes known to him, then he shall bring his gift, a he-goat from the goats, a male without blemish.

**Leviticus 4:24**

And he shall lay his hand on the head of the he-goat, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings before the Lord. It is a sin-offering.

**Leviticus 4:25**

And the priest shall place some of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings.

**Leviticus 4:26**

And he shall offer all its fat on the altar, just like the fat of the sacrifice of salvation. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 4:27**

And if one person from the people of the land sins unintentionally by doing one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and becomes guilty,

**Leviticus 4:28**

and the sin that he sinned becomes known to him, then he shall bring a female goat from the goats, without blemish, for the sin that he sinned.

**Leviticus 4:29**

And he shall lay his hand on the head of his sin-offering, and they shall slaughter the female goat of the sin-offering in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings.

**Leviticus 4:30**

And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and place it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offerings, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar.

**Leviticus 4:31**

And he shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the sacrifice of salvation, and the priest shall offer it on the altar as an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. And the priest shall make atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 4:32**

And if he brings a sheep as his gift for sin, he shall bring a female without blemish.

**Leviticus 4:33**

And he shall lay his hand on the head of the sin-offering, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings.

**Leviticus 4:34**

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin-offering with his finger and place it on the horns of the altar of whole burnt offering, and he shall pour out all its blood at the base of the altar of whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 4:35**

And he shall remove all its fat, just as the fat of a sheep is removed from the sacrifice of salvation, and the priest shall place it on the altar, on the Lord's whole burnt offering. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

### Chapter 5

**Leviticus 5:1**

And if a person sins and hears a sworn charge, and he is a witness or has seen or knows, if he does not report it, he shall bear the sin.

**Leviticus 5:2**

Or if a person touches any unclean thing, whether the carcass of an unclean wild beast, or carcasses of unclean abominations, or carcasses of unclean cattle,

**Leviticus 5:3**

or touches human uncleanness, any uncleanness by which, when touching it, he would be defiled, and it escapes him, but afterward he knows and becomes guilty,

**Leviticus 5:4**

or if a person swears, rashly speaking with the lips, to do evil or to do good, according to whatever a man may utter with an oath, and it escapes him before his eyes, and later he knows and sins in one of these things,

**Leviticus 5:5**

then he shall confess the sin in which he has sinned.

**Leviticus 5:6**

And he shall bring to the Lord for what he became guilty in, for the sin that he sinned, a female from the sheep, a ewe lamb or a female goat, for sin, and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 5:7**

And if his hand is not strong enough for a sheep, he shall bring for his sin that he sinned two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 5:8**

And he shall bring them to the priest, and the priest shall bring the one for sin first, and the priest shall pinch off its head from the neck, but shall not divide it.

**Leviticus 5:9**

And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the one for sin on the wall of the altar, and the rest of the blood he shall drain out at the base of the altar, for it is a sin-offering.

**Leviticus 5:10**

And he shall make the second one a whole burnt offering, as is proper, and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin that he sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 5:11**

And if his hand cannot find a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his gift for the sin that he sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for sin. He shall not pour oil on it, nor place frankincense on it, because it is a sin-offering.

**Leviticus 5:12**

And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest, taking from it a full handful, its memorial portion, shall place it on the altar of whole burnt offerings to the Lord. It is a sin-offering.

**Leviticus 5:13**

And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin that he sinned in one of these things, and it shall be forgiven him. And what remains shall belong to the priest, like the sacrifice of fine flour.

**Leviticus 5:14**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 5:15**

If a person slips in forgetfulness and sins unintentionally in the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring for his trespass to the Lord a ram without blemish from the sheep, valued in silver shekels by the sanctuary shekel, for the thing in which he trespassed.

**Leviticus 5:16**

And what he sinned from the holy things he shall repay, and he shall add a fifth to it and give it to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of trespass, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 5:17**

And if a person sins and does one of all the commands of the Lord that must not be done, and he does not know it, yet becomes guilty and bears the sin,

**Leviticus 5:18**

then he shall bring a ram without blemish from the sheep, valued in silver, for trespass to the priest. And the priest shall make atonement for him for his ignorance that he committed in ignorance, and he did not know it, and it shall be forgiven him.

**Leviticus 5:19**

For by guilt he has been guilty before the Lord.

**Leviticus 5:20**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 5:21**

If a person sins and deliberately overlooks the commands of the Lord and lies about matters concerning his neighbor, in a deposit or in a partnership or in a robbery, or has wronged his neighbor in something,

**Leviticus 5:22**

or has found something lost and lies about it and swears unjustly concerning any one of all the things that a person may do so as to sin in them,

**Leviticus 5:23**

then it shall be, whenever he sins and becomes guilty, that he shall restore the plunder that he seized, or the wrong that he committed, or the deposit entrusted to him, or the lost thing that he found,

**Leviticus 5:24**

from any matter about which he swore unjustly, he shall repay its principal and add a fifth to it. He shall give it to the one to whom it belongs on the day he is convicted.

**Leviticus 5:25**

And for his trespass he shall bring to the Lord a ram from the sheep, without blemish, valued for the matter in which he trespassed.

**Leviticus 5:26**

And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and it shall be forgiven him for any one of all the things that he did and trespassed in.

### Chapter 6

**Leviticus 6:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 6:2**

Charge Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the whole burnt offering: this is the whole burnt offering on its burning upon the altar all night until morning, and the fire of the altar shall burn on it; it shall not be extinguished.

**Leviticus 6:3**

And the priest shall put on a linen tunic, and he shall put linen undergarments around his body, and he shall remove the ashes that the fire consumed from the whole burnt offering on the altar, and he shall place them beside the altar.

**Leviticus 6:4**

And he shall take off his garment and put on another garment, and he shall carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

**Leviticus 6:5**

And the fire on the altar shall burn upon it and shall not be extinguished, and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning and stack the whole burnt offering upon it, and he shall place on it the fat of the sacrifice of salvation.

**Leviticus 6:6**

And fire shall burn continually on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.

**Leviticus 6:7**

This is the law of the sacrifice that the sons of Aaron shall bring before the Lord, before the altar.

**Leviticus 6:8**

And he shall take from it with his handful from the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil and all the frankincense that is on the sacrifice, and he shall offer on the altar an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance, its memorial to the Lord.

**Leviticus 6:9**

And Aaron and his sons shall eat what is left of it. It shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; they shall eat it in the court of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 6:10**

It shall not be baked leavened. I have given it to them as a portion from the Lord's offerings. It is holy of holies, like that for sin and like that for trespass.

**Leviticus 6:11**

Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is an everlasting statute throughout your generations from the Lord's offerings. Everyone who touches them shall be sanctified.

**Leviticus 6:12**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 6:13**

This is the gift of Aaron and of his sons that they shall bring to the Lord on the day when he anoints him: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a continual sacrifice, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

**Leviticus 6:14**

It shall be made on a griddle with oil. He shall bring it well mixed, a sacrifice rolled out in pieces, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.

**Leviticus 6:15**

The anointed priest in his place from among his sons shall make it. It is an everlasting statute. It shall all be completely offered.

**Leviticus 6:16**

And every sacrifice of a priest shall be wholly burned and shall not be eaten.

**Leviticus 6:17**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 6:18**

Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the thing for sin: in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offering, they shall slaughter the things for sin before the Lord. It is holy of holies.

**Leviticus 6:19**

The priest who offers it shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 6:20**

Everyone touching its flesh shall be sanctified, and whatever garment is sprinkled with some of its blood, you shall wash what was sprinkled on it in a holy place.

**Leviticus 6:21**

And the earthen vessel in which it was boiled shall be broken. And if it was boiled in a bronze vessel, he shall scour it and rinse it with water.

**Leviticus 6:22**

Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is holy of holies to the Lord.

**Leviticus 6:23**

And every thing for sin, from whose blood some is brought into the tent of testimony to make atonement in the holy place, shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

### Chapter 7

**Leviticus 7:1**

And this is the law of the ram for trespass. It is holy of holies.

**Leviticus 7:2**

In the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offering, they shall slaughter the ram of trespass before the Lord, and he shall pour the blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 7:3**

And he shall bring from it all its fat, and the loin, and all the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,

**Leviticus 7:4**

and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that on the thighs, and he shall remove the lobe above the liver with the kidneys.

**Leviticus 7:5**

And the priest shall offer them on the altar, an offering to the Lord. It is for trespass.

**Leviticus 7:6**

Every male among the priests shall eat them. They shall eat them in a holy place. It is holy of holies.

**Leviticus 7:7**

As the thing for sin, so also the thing for trespass. There is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with it, it shall belong to him.

**Leviticus 7:8**

And the priest who offers a person's whole burnt offering, the skin of the whole burnt offering that he offers shall belong to him.

**Leviticus 7:9**

And every sacrifice that is prepared in the oven, and everything that is prepared on the hearth-pan or on the griddle, shall belong to the priest who offers it.

**Leviticus 7:10**

And every sacrifice mixed with oil and not mixed with oil shall belong equally to all the sons of Aaron.

**Leviticus 7:11**

This is the law of the sacrifice of salvation that they shall bring to the Lord.

**Leviticus 7:12**

If he brings it for praise, then on the sacrifice of praise he shall bring loaves from fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and fine flour well mixed with oil.

**Leviticus 7:13**

With leavened loaves he shall bring his gifts with the sacrifice of praise of salvation.

**Leviticus 7:14**

And he shall bring one from all his gifts as a contribution to the Lord. It shall belong to the priest who pours out the blood of the sacrifice of salvation.

**Leviticus 7:15**

And the flesh of the sacrifice of praise of salvation shall belong to him, and it shall be eaten on the day it is offered. They shall not leave any of it until morning.

**Leviticus 7:16**

And if his gift is a vow or a voluntary offering, on the day when he offers his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day,

**Leviticus 7:17**

and what remains from the flesh of the sacrifice until the third day shall be burned with fire.

**Leviticus 7:18**

And if anyone eats from the flesh on the third day, it shall not be accepted for the one who offers it. It shall not be reckoned to him. It is pollution, and the person who eats from it shall bear the sin.

**Leviticus 7:19**

And flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. Every clean person may eat flesh.

**Leviticus 7:20**

And the person who eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of salvation, which belongs to the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that person shall perish from his people.

**Leviticus 7:21**

And if a person touches any unclean thing, whether human uncleanness or unclean quadrupeds or any unclean abomination, and eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of salvation, which belongs to the Lord, that person shall perish from his people.

**Leviticus 7:22**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 7:23**

Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, You shall eat no fat of cattle or sheep or goats.

**Leviticus 7:24**

And the fat of animals that died on their own or were torn by beasts may be used for any work, but for eating it shall not be eaten.

**Leviticus 7:25**

Everyone who eats fat from the animals from which they bring an offering to the Lord, that person shall perish from his people.

**Leviticus 7:26**

You shall eat no blood in all your dwellings, whether from birds or from cattle.

**Leviticus 7:27**

Every person who eats blood, that person shall perish from his people.

**Leviticus 7:28**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 7:29**

And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, The one who brings a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord shall bring his gift to the Lord from the sacrifice of salvation.

**Leviticus 7:30**

His hands shall bring the Lord's offerings: the fat on the breast and the lobe of the liver he shall bring them to set them as a gift before the Lord.

**Leviticus 7:31**

And the priest shall offer the fat on the altar, and the breast shall belong to Aaron and to his sons.

**Leviticus 7:32**

And you shall give the right arm as a contribution to the priest from your sacrifices of salvation.

**Leviticus 7:33**

The one from among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the sacrifice of salvation and the fat, to him the right arm shall belong as a portion.

**Leviticus 7:34**

For I have taken the breast of the presentation and the arm of the contribution from the sons of Israel, from your sacrifices of salvation, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an everlasting statute from the sons of Israel.

**Leviticus 7:35**

This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his sons from the Lord's offerings, on the day when he brought them to serve as priests to the Lord,

**Leviticus 7:36**

just as the Lord commanded to give to them on the day he anointed them, from the sons of Israel, an everlasting statute throughout their generations.

**Leviticus 7:37**

This is the law of the whole burnt offerings and of sacrifice and of the thing for sin and of trespass and of consecration and of the sacrifice of salvation,

**Leviticus 7:38**

just as the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when he commanded the sons of Israel to bring their gifts before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.

### Chapter 8

**Leviticus 8:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 8:2**

Take Aaron and his sons, and his garments, and the anointing oil, and the calf for sin, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,

**Leviticus 8:3**

and assemble all the congregation at the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 8:4**

And Moses did just as the Lord commanded him, and he assembled the congregation at the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 8:5**

And Moses said to the congregation, This is the word that the Lord commanded to be done.

**Leviticus 8:6**

And Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.

**Leviticus 8:7**

And he put the tunic on him, and girded him with the sash, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him, and girded him according to the making of the ephod, and bound him in it.

**Leviticus 8:8**

And he put the breastpiece on it, and on the breastpiece he put the Manifestation and the Truth.

**Leviticus 8:9**

And he put the turban on his head, and on the turban, at the front of it, he put the golden plate, the sanctified holy thing, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 8:10**

And Moses took some of the anointing oil.

**Leviticus 8:11**

And he sprinkled from it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and sanctified it, and all its utensils, and the laver and its base, and sanctified them. And he anointed the tent and everything in it, and sanctified it.

**Leviticus 8:12**

And Moses poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him and sanctified him.

**Leviticus 8:13**

And Moses brought Aaron's sons near and clothed them with tunics and girded them with sashes and put caps on them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 8:14**

And Moses brought near the calf for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the calf for sin.

**Leviticus 8:15**

And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of the blood and put it on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement on it.

**Leviticus 8:16**

And Moses took all the fat on the inward parts, and the lobe above the liver, and both kidneys, and the fat on them, and Moses offered them on the altar.

**Leviticus 8:17**

And the calf and its hide and its flesh and its dung he burned with fire outside the camp, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 8:18**

And Moses brought near the ram for whole burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

**Leviticus 8:19**

And Moses slaughtered the ram and poured the blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 8:20**

And he cut the ram into limbs, and Moses offered the head and the limbs and the fat.

**Leviticus 8:21**

And he washed the belly and the feet with water, and Moses offered the whole ram on the altar. It was a whole burnt offering for an aroma of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 8:22**

And Moses brought near the second ram, the ram of completion, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

**Leviticus 8:23**

And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot.

**Leviticus 8:24**

And Moses brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears and on the tips of their right hands and on the tips of their right feet, and Moses poured the blood around on the altar.

**Leviticus 8:25**

And he took the fat and the loin and the fat on the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat on them and the right arm.

**Leviticus 8:26**

And from the basket of completion that was before the Lord he took one unleavened loaf and one loaf of oil and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and the right arm.

**Leviticus 8:27**

And he placed all of them on Aaron's hands and on the hands of his sons, and offered them as a contribution before the Lord.

**Leviticus 8:28**

And Moses took them from their hands and offered them on the altar, on the whole burnt offering of completion. It is an aroma of sweet fragrance, an offering to the Lord.

**Leviticus 8:29**

And Moses, taking the breast, presented it before the Lord from the ram of completion, and it became Moses' portion, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 8:30**

And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled it on Aaron and on his garments and on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him, and he sanctified Aaron and his garments and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.

**Leviticus 8:31**

And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh in the court of the tent of testimony, in a holy place, and there eat it, and the loaves in the basket of completion, just as it has been ordered to me, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat them.

**Leviticus 8:32**

And what remains of the flesh and of the loaves shall be burned with fire.

**Leviticus 8:33**

And you shall not go out from the door of the tent of testimony for seven days, until the day of your completion is fulfilled, for seven days he will consecrate your hands.

**Leviticus 8:34**

Just as he did on this day, the Lord commanded to do, so as to make atonement for you.

**Leviticus 8:35**

And at the door of the tent of testimony you shall sit seven days, day and night, and you shall keep the Lord's charges, so that you may not die. For thus the Lord God commanded me.

**Leviticus 8:36**

And Aaron and his sons did all the words that the Lord commanded Moses.

### Chapter 9

**Leviticus 9:1**

And it happened on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

**Leviticus 9:2**

And Moses said to Aaron, Take for yourself a calf from the cattle for sin and a ram for whole burnt offering, both without blemish, and bring them before the Lord.

**Leviticus 9:3**

And to the elders of Israel speak, saying, Take one he-goat from the goats for sin, and a calf and a year-old lamb, both without blemish, for whole burnt offering,

**Leviticus 9:4**

and a calf and a ram for a sacrifice of salvation before the Lord, and fine flour mixed with oil, because today the Lord will appear among you.

**Leviticus 9:5**

And they took what Moses commanded before the tent of testimony, and all the congregation came near and stood before the Lord.

**Leviticus 9:6**

And Moses said, This is the word that the Lord spoke: Do it, and the glory of the Lord will appear among you.

**Leviticus 9:7**

And Moses said to Aaron, Come near to the altar and make your sin-offering and your whole burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and for your house, and make the gifts of the people and make atonement for them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 9:8**

And Aaron came near to the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin-offering.

**Leviticus 9:9**

And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, and he poured the blood out at the base of the altar.

**Leviticus 9:10**

And the fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver of the sin-offering he offered on the altar, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 9:11**

And the flesh and the hide he burned with fire outside the camp.

**Leviticus 9:12**

And he slaughtered the whole burnt offering, and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it around on the altar.

**Leviticus 9:13**

And they brought the whole burnt offering to him piece by piece, and the head, and he placed them on the altar.

**Leviticus 9:14**

And he washed the belly and the feet with water and placed them on the whole burnt offering on the altar.

**Leviticus 9:15**

And they brought the people's gift, and he took the he-goat for the people's sin-offering and slaughtered it and purified it just like the first.

**Leviticus 9:16**

And he brought the whole burnt offering and made it as is proper.

**Leviticus 9:17**

And he brought the sacrifice and filled his hands from it and placed it on the altar, apart from the morning whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 9:18**

And he slaughtered the calf and the ram of the people's sacrifice of salvation, and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it around on the altar.

**Leviticus 9:19**

And the fat from the calf and from the ram, the loin and the fat covering the belly and the two kidneys and the fat on them and the lobe above the liver,

**Leviticus 9:20**

and he placed the fats on the breasts, and they offered the fats on the altar.

**Leviticus 9:21**

And Aaron presented the breast and the right arm before the Lord as a contribution, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 9:22**

And Aaron, lifting up his hands over the people, blessed them, and he came down after making the sin-offering and the whole burnt offerings and the things of salvation.

**Leviticus 9:23**

And Moses and Aaron entered into the tent of testimony, and coming out they blessed all the people, and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.

**Leviticus 9:24**

And fire came out from the Lord and consumed on the altar the whole burnt offerings and the fats, and all the people saw and were astonished and fell on their faces.

### Chapter 10

**Leviticus 10:1**

And the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, each taking his firepan, put fire in it and put incense on it and brought foreign fire before the Lord, which the Lord had not commanded them.

**Leviticus 10:2**

And fire came out from the Lord and consumed them, and they died before the Lord.

**Leviticus 10:3**

And Moses said to Aaron, This is what the Lord said, saying, Among those drawing near to me I will be sanctified, and before all the congregation I will be glorified. And Aaron was pierced.

**Leviticus 10:4**

And Moses called Misael and Elisaphan, sons of Uzziel, sons of Aaron's father's brother, and said to them, Come near and carry your brothers from before the holy things, outside the camp.

**Leviticus 10:5**

And they came near and carried them in their tunics outside the camp, just as Moses said.

**Leviticus 10:6**

And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who remained, Do not uncover your heads and do not tear your garments, so that you may not die and wrath come upon all the congregation. But your brothers, the whole house of Israel, shall mourn the burning with which they were burned by the Lord.

**Leviticus 10:7**

And you shall not go out from the door of the tent of testimony, so that you may not die, for the anointing oil from the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

**Leviticus 10:8**

And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,

**Leviticus 10:9**

Wine and strong drink you shall not drink, you and your sons with you, whenever you enter into the tent of testimony or when you approach the altar, and you shall certainly not die. It is an everlasting statute throughout your generations,

**Leviticus 10:10**

to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean,

**Leviticus 10:11**

and you shall instruct the sons of Israel in all the statutes that the Lord spoke to them by the hand of Moses.

**Leviticus 10:12**

And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who remained, Take the sacrifice left from the Lord's offerings and eat it unleavened beside the altar, because it is holy of holies.

**Leviticus 10:13**

And you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is a statute for you and a statute for your sons from the Lord's offerings, for thus it has been commanded to me.

**Leviticus 10:14**

And you shall eat the breast of separation and the arm of contribution in a holy place, you and your sons and your house with you, because it has been given as a statute for you and a statute for your sons from the sacrifices of salvation of the sons of Israel.

**Leviticus 10:15**

They shall bring the arm of contribution and the breast of separation with the offerings of the fats, to set them apart before the Lord, and it shall belong to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as an everlasting statute, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

**Leviticus 10:16**

And Moses sought diligently for the he-goat for sin, and see, it had been burned up, and Moses was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who remained, saying,

**Leviticus 10:17**

Why did you not eat the thing for sin in the holy place? For it is holy of holies, and he gave it to you to eat, so that you might take away the sin of the congregation and make atonement for them before the Lord.

**Leviticus 10:18**

For its blood was not brought inside into the holy place. You certainly should have eaten it in the holy place, just as the Lord commanded me.

**Leviticus 10:19**

And Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, If today they have brought near their things for sin and their whole burnt offerings before the Lord, and these things have happened to me, and were I to eat the things for sin today, would it be pleasing to the Lord?

**Leviticus 10:20**

And Moses heard, and it pleased him.

### Chapter 11

**Leviticus 11:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

**Leviticus 11:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, These are the animals that you shall eat from all the animals upon the earth.

**Leviticus 11:3**

Every animal that divides the hoof and splits the hoof in two and chews the cud among the animals, these you shall eat.

**Leviticus 11:4**

But from these you shall not eat: from those chewing the cud and from those dividing the hoof and splitting the claws. The camel, because it chews the cud, but does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:5**

And the hare, because it chews the cud, but does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:6**

And the rock-badger, because it chews the cud, but does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:7**

And the pig, because it divides the hoof and splits the hoof-claws, but does not chew the cud, it is unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:8**

From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall not touch. They are unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:9**

And these are what you shall eat from all that are in the waters: everything that has fins and scales in the waters, and in the seas, and in the streams, these you shall eat.

**Leviticus 11:10**

And everything that does not have fins or scales in the water, or in the seas, and in the streams, from everything with which the waters teem and from every living creature in the water, is an abomination.

**Leviticus 11:11**

And they shall be abominations to you. From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall abhor.

**Leviticus 11:12**

Everything in the waters that does not have fins and scales, this is an abomination to you.

**Leviticus 11:13**

And these you shall abhor from among the birds; they shall not be eaten. They are an abomination: the eagle and the griffin and the sea-eagle,

**Leviticus 11:14**

and the vulture and the kite and those like it,

**Leviticus 11:15**

and every raven and those like it,

**Leviticus 11:16**

and the ostrich and the owl and the gull and those like it, and the hawk and those like it,

**Leviticus 11:17**

and the night-raven and the diver and the ibis,

**Leviticus 11:18**

and the water-hen and the pelican and the swan,

**Leviticus 11:19**

and the heron and the plover and those like it, and the hoopoe and the bat.

**Leviticus 11:20**

And every winged creeping thing that goes on four feet is an abomination to you.

**Leviticus 11:21**

But these you may eat from the winged creeping things that go on four feet, which have legs above their feet to leap with on the ground.

**Leviticus 11:22**

And these of them you may eat: the locust and those like it, and the attacus and those like it, and the grasshopper and those like it, and the serpent-fighter and those like it.

**Leviticus 11:23**

Every winged creeping thing that has four feet is an abomination to you.

**Leviticus 11:24**

And by these you shall become unclean. Everyone touching their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:25**

And everyone carrying their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:26**

Among all the animals, anything that divides the hoof and splits the claw, but does not chew the cud, shall be unclean to you. Everyone touching their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:27**

And everyone among the wild beasts that goes on forepaws, that goes on all fours, is unclean to you. Everyone touching their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:28**

And the one carrying their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening. These are unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:29**

And these are unclean to you from among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel and the mouse and the land-crocodile,

**Leviticus 11:30**

the shrew and the chameleon and the lizard and the lizard-kind and the mole,

**Leviticus 11:31**

these are unclean to you from all the creeping things on the earth. Everyone touching them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:32**

And anything on which one of them falls, after they are dead, shall be unclean, whether any wooden vessel or garment or skin or sack, every vessel in which work is done. It shall be dipped in water and be unclean until evening, and then it shall be clean.

**Leviticus 11:33**

And every earthen vessel into which one of these falls inside, everything inside it shall be unclean, and the vessel itself shall be broken.

**Leviticus 11:34**

And every food that is eaten, if water comes on it, shall be unclean. And every drink that is drunk in any vessel shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 11:35**

And everything on which any of their carcasses falls shall be unclean. Ovens and cooking-stands shall be torn down. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:36**

Only springs of waters and cisterns and gatherings of water shall be clean, but the one touching their carcasses shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 11:37**

And if any of their carcasses falls upon any seed for sowing that is to be sown, it shall be clean.

**Leviticus 11:38**

But if water is poured on any seed and any of their carcasses falls upon it, it is unclean to you.

**Leviticus 11:39**

And if one of the animals that are for you to eat dies, the one touching its carcass shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:40**

And the one eating from their carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening, and the one carrying from their carcasses shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 11:41**

And every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

**Leviticus 11:42**

Everything that goes on its belly, and everything that goes on four feet, and everything with many feet among all the creeping things that creep upon the earth, you shall not eat, because it is an abomination to you.

**Leviticus 11:43**

And you shall not make your lives abominable among all the creeping things that creep on the earth, and you shall not be defiled by them, and you shall not become unclean by them.

**Leviticus 11:44**

For I am the Lord your God, and you shall be sanctified and shall be holy, because I am holy, the Lord your God. And you shall not defile your lives among all the creeping things moving on the earth.

**Leviticus 11:45**

For I am the Lord who brought you up from the land of Egypt to be your God, and you shall be holy, because I am holy, the Lord.

**Leviticus 11:46**

This is the law concerning the animals and the birds and every living creature moving in the water and every living creature creeping upon the earth,

**Leviticus 11:47**

to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the living things that may be eaten and the living things that may not be eaten.

### Chapter 12

**Leviticus 12:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 12:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If a woman conceives seed and bears a male, she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation of her monthly flow she shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 12:3**

And on the eighth day he shall circumcise the flesh of his foreskin.

**Leviticus 12:4**

And for thirty-three days she shall sit in the blood of her uncleanness. She shall touch nothing holy, and she shall not enter into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are fulfilled.

**Leviticus 12:5**

But if she bears a female, she shall be unclean for twice seven days, according to the time of her monthly flow, and for sixty-six days she shall sit in the blood of her uncleanness.

**Leviticus 12:6**

And when the days of her purification are fulfilled, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a year-old lamb without blemish for whole burnt offering, and a young pigeon or turtledove for sin, to the door of the tent of testimony, to the priest.

**Leviticus 12:7**

And he shall bring it before the Lord, and the priest shall make atonement for her and cleanse her from the fountain of her blood. This is the law of the one bearing a male or a female.

**Leviticus 12:8**

And if her hand does not find what is sufficient for a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for whole burnt offering and one for sin, and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed.

### Chapter 13

**Leviticus 13:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

**Leviticus 13:2**

If a person has on the skin of his flesh a swelling or a bright mark or a shining spot, and it becomes on the skin of his flesh a mark of skin-disease, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.

**Leviticus 13:3**

And the priest shall inspect the mark on the skin of his flesh, and if the hair in the mark has turned white and the appearance of the mark is deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a mark of skin-disease. And the priest shall inspect him and pronounce him unclean.

**Leviticus 13:4**

But if the bright spot is white on the skin of his flesh, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, and it is dim, then the priest shall isolate the mark seven days.

**Leviticus 13:5**

And the priest shall inspect the mark on the seventh day, and if the mark remains before him and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall isolate him a second seven days.

**Leviticus 13:6**

And the priest shall inspect him the second time on the seventh day, and if the mark is dim and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is a mark only. And after washing his garments, he shall be clean.

**Leviticus 13:7**

But if the mark does spread in the skin after the priest has seen him to cleanse him, he shall appear a second time to the priest.

**Leviticus 13:8**

And the priest shall inspect him, and if the mark has spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is skin-disease.

**Leviticus 13:9**

And if a mark of skin-disease arises in a person, he shall come to the priest.

**Leviticus 13:10**

And the priest shall inspect, and if there is a white swelling in the skin and it has turned the hair white, and there is healthy living flesh in the swelling,

**Leviticus 13:11**

it is an old skin-disease in the skin of his flesh. And the priest shall pronounce him unclean and shall not isolate him, because he is unclean.

**Leviticus 13:12**

But if the skin-disease breaks out and spreads in the skin and the skin-disease covers all the skin of the mark from head to foot, as far as the priest can see,

**Leviticus 13:13**

then the priest shall inspect, and if the skin-disease has covered all the skin of the flesh, the priest shall pronounce the mark clean, because it has all turned white. He is clean.

**Leviticus 13:14**

But on whatever day living flesh appears in him, he shall be pronounced unclean.

**Leviticus 13:15**

And the priest shall inspect the healthy flesh and pronounce him unclean. The healthy flesh is unclean. It is skin-disease.

**Leviticus 13:16**

But if the healthy flesh is restored and turns white, then he shall come to the priest.

**Leviticus 13:17**

And the priest shall inspect, and if the mark has turned white, the priest shall pronounce the mark clean. He is clean.

**Leviticus 13:18**

And if flesh has in its skin an ulcer and it is healed,

**Leviticus 13:19**

and there comes in the place of the ulcer a white swelling or a white bright spot tinged reddish, then it shall be shown to the priest.

**Leviticus 13:20**

And the priest shall inspect, and if its appearance is lower than the skin and its hair has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a mark of skin-disease; it has broken out in the ulcer.

**Leviticus 13:21**

But if the priest inspects and there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin of the flesh, and it is dim, the priest shall isolate him seven days.

**Leviticus 13:22**

And if it does spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a mark of skin-disease; it has broken out in the ulcer.

**Leviticus 13:23**

But if the bright spot remains in its place and does not spread, it is the scar of the ulcer, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

**Leviticus 13:24**

And if flesh has in its skin a burn of fire, and the healed part of the burn becomes a bright spot, white tinged red or pure white,

**Leviticus 13:25**

then the priest shall inspect it, and if the hair in the bright spot has turned white and its appearance is lower than the skin, it is skin-disease; it has broken out in the burn. And the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a mark of skin-disease.

**Leviticus 13:26**

But if the priest inspects and there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is dim, the priest shall isolate him seven days.

**Leviticus 13:27**

And the priest shall inspect him on the seventh day. If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a mark of skin-disease.

**Leviticus 13:28**

But if the bright spot remains in its place and does not spread in the skin, and it is dim, it is the scar of the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the mark of the burn.

**Leviticus 13:29**

And if a man or a woman has a mark on the head or on the beard,

**Leviticus 13:30**

the priest shall inspect the mark, and if its appearance is deeper than the skin and there is in it thin yellowish hair, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a scaly patch; it is skin-disease of the head or skin-disease of the beard.

**Leviticus 13:31**

But if the priest inspects the mark of the scaly patch and its appearance is not deeper than the skin and there is no yellowish hair in it, the priest shall isolate the mark of the scaly patch seven days.

**Leviticus 13:32**

And the priest shall inspect the mark on the seventh day, and if the scaly patch has not spread, and there is no yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the scaly patch is not hollow beneath the skin,

**Leviticus 13:33**

then he shall shave himself, but the scaly patch he shall not shave, and the priest shall isolate the scaly patch a second seven days.

**Leviticus 13:34**

And the priest shall inspect the scaly patch on the seventh day, and if the scaly patch has not spread in the skin after the shaving, and its appearance is not deeper than the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean. And after washing his garments, he shall be clean.

**Leviticus 13:35**

But if the scaly patch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

**Leviticus 13:36**

then the priest shall inspect, and if the scaly patch has spread in the skin, the priest need not search for the yellowish hair, because he is unclean.

**Leviticus 13:37**

But if in his sight the scaly patch stays in place and black hair grows in it, the scaly patch is healed. He is clean, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

**Leviticus 13:38**

And if a man or a woman has on the skin of the flesh bright spots, pale white bright spots,

**Leviticus 13:39**

then the priest shall inspect, and if on the skin of their flesh there are pale white bright spots, it is a white eruption. It has broken out in the skin of his flesh. He is clean.

**Leviticus 13:40**

And if a man loses the hair of his head, he is bald. He is clean.

**Leviticus 13:41**

And if he loses the hair of his head at the front, he is forehead-bald. He is clean.

**Leviticus 13:42**

But if there is on his baldness or on his forehead-baldness a white or reddish mark, it is skin-disease in his baldness or in his forehead-baldness.

**Leviticus 13:43**

And the priest shall inspect him, and if the appearance of the mark is white tinged red on his baldness or his forehead-baldness, like the appearance of skin-disease in the skin of flesh,

**Leviticus 13:44**

he is a person with skin-disease. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His mark is on his head.

**Leviticus 13:45**

And the one with skin-disease in whom the mark is, his garments shall be loosened and his head uncovered, and he shall cover around his mouth and cry out, Unclean, unclean.

**Leviticus 13:46**

All the days that the mark is upon him, he shall be unclean. Being unclean, he shall dwell apart. His dwelling shall be outside the camp.

**Leviticus 13:47**

And if in a garment there is a mark of skin-disease, whether in a woolen garment or in a linen garment,

**Leviticus 13:48**

or in warp or in woof, whether in linen or in wool, or in leather or in any article made of leather,

**Leviticus 13:49**

and the mark becomes greenish or reddish in the garment or in the leather or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of leather, it is a mark of skin-disease and shall be shown to the priest.

**Leviticus 13:50**

And the priest shall inspect the mark and isolate the mark seven days.

**Leviticus 13:51**

And the priest shall inspect the mark on the seventh day. If the mark has spread in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in the leather, in whatever is made of leather for use, the mark is persistent skin-disease. It is unclean.

**Leviticus 13:52**

He shall burn the garment, or the warp or the woof, whether in wool or in linen, or any leather article in which the mark is, because it is persistent skin-disease. It shall be burned with fire.

**Leviticus 13:53**

But if the priest inspects and the mark has not spread in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any leather article,

**Leviticus 13:54**

then the priest shall command, and they shall wash that in which the mark is, and the priest shall isolate the mark a second seven days.

**Leviticus 13:55**

And the priest shall inspect after the mark has been washed, and if the mark has not changed its appearance and the mark has not spread, it is unclean. It shall be burned with fire. It is fixed in the garment or in the warp or in the woof.

**Leviticus 13:56**

But if the priest inspects and the mark is dim after it has been washed, he shall tear it out of the garment or out of the leather or out of the warp or out of the woof.

**Leviticus 13:57**

But if it still appears in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any leather article, it is skin-disease breaking out. Whatever has the mark shall be burned with fire.

**Leviticus 13:58**

And the garment or the warp or the woof or any leather article that is washed, and the mark departs from it, shall be washed a second time and shall be clean.

**Leviticus 13:59**

This is the law of the mark of skin-disease in a woolen garment or linen garment or warp or woof or any leather article, to pronounce it clean or to pronounce it unclean.

### Chapter 14

**Leviticus 14:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

**Leviticus 14:2**

This is the law for the one with skin-disease on the day he is cleansed: he shall be brought to the priest.

**Leviticus 14:3**

And the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest shall inspect, and if the mark of the skin-disease has been healed from the one with skin-disease,

**Leviticus 14:4**

then the priest shall command, and they shall take for the one being cleansed two living clean birds and cedar wood and spun scarlet and hyssop.

**Leviticus 14:5**

And the priest shall command, and they shall slaughter the one bird in an earthen vessel over living water.

**Leviticus 14:6**

And he shall take the living bird and the cedar wood and the spun scarlet and the hyssop, and dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over living water.

**Leviticus 14:7**

And he shall sprinkle seven times on the one cleansed from the skin-disease, and he shall be clean. And he shall release the living bird into the open field.

**Leviticus 14:8**

And the one being cleansed shall wash his garments and shave all his hair and bathe in water and be clean. And after these things he shall enter into the camp and remain outside his house seven days.

**Leviticus 14:9**

And it shall be on the seventh day: he shall shave all his hair, his head and his beard and his eyebrows, all his hair he shall shave, and he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be clean.

**Leviticus 14:10**

And on the eighth day he shall take two year-old lambs without blemish and one year-old ewe without blemish and three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for sacrifice and one cup of oil.

**Leviticus 14:11**

And the priest who cleanses shall present the person being cleansed and these things before the Lord at the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 14:12**

And the priest shall take the one lamb and bring it for trespass, and the cup of oil, and present them before the Lord as a contribution.

**Leviticus 14:13**

And they shall slaughter the lamb in the place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings and the things for sin, in a holy place, for as the thing for sin, so also the thing for trespass belongs to the priest. It is holy of holies.

**Leviticus 14:14**

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the thing for trespass, and the priest shall place it on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot.

**Leviticus 14:15**

And the priest, taking some of the cup of oil, shall pour it on the priest's left hand.

**Leviticus 14:16**

And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is on his left hand and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord.

**Leviticus 14:17**

And the oil remaining in his hand the priest shall place on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the thing for trespass.

**Leviticus 14:18**

And the oil remaining on the priest's hand the priest shall place on the head of the one cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.

**Leviticus 14:19**

And the priest shall make the thing for sin, and the priest shall make atonement for the unclean one being cleansed from his sin, and after this the priest shall slaughter the whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 14:20**

And the priest shall offer the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice on the altar before the Lord, and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be cleansed.

**Leviticus 14:21**

But if he is poor and his hand cannot find enough, he shall take one lamb for the thing in which he trespassed, as a contribution to make atonement for him, and one tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for sacrifice, and one cup of oil,

**Leviticus 14:22**

and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whatever his hand can find, and one shall be for sin and one for whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 14:23**

And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the tent of testimony, before the Lord.

**Leviticus 14:24**

And the priest shall take the lamb for trespass and the cup of oil and present them before the Lord as a presentation.

**Leviticus 14:25**

And he shall slaughter the lamb for trespass, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the thing for trespass and place it on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot.

**Leviticus 14:26**

And some of the oil the priest shall pour on the priest's left hand.

**Leviticus 14:27**

And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord.

**Leviticus 14:28**

And the priest shall place some of the oil on his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one being cleansed and on the tip of his right hand and on the tip of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the thing for trespass.

**Leviticus 14:29**

And what remains of the oil on the priest's hand the priest shall place on the head of the one cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.

**Leviticus 14:30**

And he shall make one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons, whatever his hand can find,

**Leviticus 14:31**

the one for sin and the one for whole burnt offering with the sacrifice, and the priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the one being cleansed.

**Leviticus 14:32**

This is the law for the one in whom is the mark of skin-disease, and whose hand does not find enough for his cleansing.

**Leviticus 14:33**

And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

**Leviticus 14:34**

When you enter into the land of the Canaanites, which I give you for a possession, and I place a mark of skin-disease in the houses of the land of your possession,

**Leviticus 14:35**

then the one whose house it is shall come and report to the priest, saying, Something like a mark has appeared to me in the house.

**Leviticus 14:36**

And the priest shall command them to empty the house before the priest goes in to inspect the mark, so that everything in the house may not become unclean. And after this the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

**Leviticus 14:37**

And he shall inspect the mark, and if the mark on the walls of the house has greenish or reddish hollows, and their appearance is deeper than the walls,

**Leviticus 14:38**

then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and the priest shall isolate the house seven days.

**Leviticus 14:39**

And the priest shall return on the seventh day and inspect, and if the mark has spread in the walls of the house,

**Leviticus 14:40**

then the priest shall command, and they shall remove the stones in which the mark is and throw them outside the city into an unclean place.

**Leviticus 14:41**

And they shall scrape the house inside all around, and they shall pour out the dust that they scraped outside the city into an unclean place.

**Leviticus 14:42**

And they shall take other stones, scraped, and put them in place of the stones, and they shall take other plaster and plaster the house.

**Leviticus 14:43**

But if the mark comes again and springs up in the house after they remove the stones and after the house is scraped and after it is plastered,

**Leviticus 14:44**

then the priest shall go in and inspect. If the mark has spread in the house, it is persistent skin-disease in the house. It is unclean.

**Leviticus 14:45**

And they shall pull down the house, and its timbers and its stones, and all its dust they shall carry outside the city into an unclean place.

**Leviticus 14:46**

And the one entering into the house all the days during which it is isolated shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 14:47**

And the one sleeping in the house shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening, and the one eating in the house shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 14:48**

But if the priest does come and inspect, and if the mark has not spread in the house after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the mark is healed.

**Leviticus 14:49**

And he shall take to purify the house two living clean birds and cedar wood and spun scarlet and hyssop.

**Leviticus 14:50**

And he shall slaughter the one bird in an earthen vessel over living water.

**Leviticus 14:51**

And he shall take the cedar wood and the spun scarlet and the hyssop and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird over living water, and with them he shall sprinkle the house seven times.

**Leviticus 14:52**

And he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird and with the living water and with the living bird and with the cedar wood and with the hyssop and with the spun scarlet.

**Leviticus 14:53**

And he shall release the living bird outside the city into the open field, and shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.

**Leviticus 14:54**

This is the law for every mark of skin-disease and scaly patch,

**Leviticus 14:55**

and for skin-disease of garment and house,

**Leviticus 14:56**

and for swelling and mark and bright spot,

**Leviticus 14:57**

to explain the day when it is unclean and the day when it is clean. This is the law of skin-disease.

### Chapter 15

**Leviticus 15:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

**Leviticus 15:2**

Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, If any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.

**Leviticus 15:3**

And this is the law of his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with the discharge or his body is stopped up from the discharge, this is his uncleanness. All the days of the discharge of his body, or if his body is stopped up by the discharge, this is his uncleanness.

**Leviticus 15:4**

Every bed on which the one with discharge lies is unclean, and every vessel on which the one with discharge sits shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 15:5**

And the person who touches his bed shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:6**

And the one sitting on the vessel on which the one with discharge sat shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:7**

And the one touching the flesh of the one with discharge shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:8**

And if the one with discharge spits on the clean person, he shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:9**

And every saddle of a donkey on which the one with discharge rides shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:10**

And everyone touching whatever is under him shall be unclean until evening, and the one carrying those things shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:11**

And whomever the one with discharge touches, if he has not washed his hands in water, he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:12**

And an earthen vessel that the one with discharge touches shall be broken, and a wooden vessel shall be washed with water and shall be clean.

**Leviticus 15:13**

And if the one with discharge is cleansed from his discharge, then he shall count seven days for his cleansing and wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be clean.

**Leviticus 15:14**

And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them before the Lord to the doors of the tent of testimony and give them to the priest.

**Leviticus 15:15**

And the priest shall make them, one for sin and one for whole burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord from his discharge.

**Leviticus 15:16**

And a man from whom an emission of seed goes out shall bathe all his body in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:17**

And every garment and every skin on which there is an emission of seed shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:18**

And if a woman lies with a man in an emission of seed, they shall bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:19**

And if a woman has a flow of blood, her flow being in her body, she shall be in her separation seven days. Everyone touching her shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:20**

And everything on which she lies during her separation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 15:21**

And everyone touching her bed shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:22**

And everyone touching any vessel on which she sits shall wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:23**

And if it is on the bed or on the vessel on which she sat, when he touches it he shall be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:24**

And if anyone lies with her and her uncleanness comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 15:25**

And if a woman has a flow of blood for many days, not at the time of her separation, or if she flows after her separation, all the days of the flow of her uncleanness, just as in the days of her separation, she shall be unclean.

**Leviticus 15:26**

And every bed on which she lies during all the days of her flow shall be to her like the bed of her separation, and every vessel on which she sits shall be unclean like the uncleanness of her separation.

**Leviticus 15:27**

Everyone touching her shall be unclean, and he shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water and be unclean until evening.

**Leviticus 15:28**

But if she is cleansed from her flow, then she shall count seven days for herself, and after this she shall be clean.

**Leviticus 15:29**

And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 15:30**

And the priest shall make the one for sin and the one for whole burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord from the flow of her uncleanness.

**Leviticus 15:31**

And you shall make the sons of Israel cautious from their uncleannesses, and they shall not die because of their uncleannesses by defiling my tent that is among them.

**Leviticus 15:32**

This is the law of the one with discharge, and of the one from whom an emission of seed goes out so as to become unclean by it,

**Leviticus 15:33**

and of the woman flowing in her separation, and of the one with discharge in his flow, for the male and for the female, and for the man who lies with a separated woman.

### Chapter 16

**Leviticus 16:1**

And the Lord spoke to Moses after the two sons of Aaron died when they brought foreign fire before the Lord, and they died.

**Leviticus 16:2**

And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at every time into the holy place within the veil, before the propitiatory that is upon the ark of testimony, so that he may not die, for in a cloud I will be seen upon the propitiatory.

**Leviticus 16:3**

Thus Aaron shall enter into the holy place: with a calf from the cattle for sin and a ram for whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 16:4**

And he shall put on the holy linen tunic, and linen undergarments shall be upon his flesh, and he shall gird himself with a linen sash, and shall put on a linen turban. They are holy garments. And he shall bathe all his body in water and put them on.

**Leviticus 16:5**

And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two he-goats from the goats for sin and one ram for whole burnt offering.

**Leviticus 16:6**

And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin and make atonement for himself and for his house.

**Leviticus 16:7**

And he shall take the two he-goats and set them before the Lord by the door of the tent of testimony.

**Leviticus 16:8**

And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two he-goats, one lot for the Lord and one lot for the sending-away goat.

**Leviticus 16:9**

And Aaron shall bring the he-goat on which the lot for the Lord fell and shall offer it for sin.

**Leviticus 16:10**

But the he-goat on which the lot of the sending-away goat fell, he shall set alive before the Lord, to make atonement over it, so as to send it away in the sending-away, into the wilderness.

**Leviticus 16:11**

And Aaron shall bring the calf for his own sin, for himself and his house alone, and make atonement for himself and for his house, and he shall slaughter the calf for his own sin.

**Leviticus 16:12**

And he shall take the firepan full of coals of fire from the altar before the Lord, and he shall fill his hands with fine blended incense and bring it within the veil.

**Leviticus 16:13**

And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the vapor of the incense shall cover the propitiatory that is over the testimonies, so that he may not die.

**Leviticus 16:14**

And he shall take some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it with his finger on the propitiatory eastward, and before the propitiatory he shall sprinkle from the blood with his finger seven times.

**Leviticus 16:15**
